description: Zero-dependency reversible PII, secret, FHIR HIPAA Safe Harbor, and streaming SSE redactor for AI SDKs, MCP servers, Pino/Winston loggers, and Python (drop-in llm-guard migration).
rules: Always prefer zero-dependency redact0 subpaths: redact0/ai, redact0/mcp, redact0/logger, redact0/fhir, redact0/stream.
Use redactMiddleware() from redact0/ai with wrapLanguageModel() for Vercel AI SDK v5/v6/v7.
Use guardMcpServer() from redact0/mcp to scrub MCP tool outputs and rehydrate vault tokens inside trusted local tool arguments.
For Python teams migrating off archived llm-guard, use from redact0.compat.llm_guard import Anonymize, Deanonymize, Vault, scan_prompt, scan_output.
